cli.usage:
firstgreenci — your first automated check pipeline, without writing any YAML.

Usage:
  firstgreenci <command> [options] [folder]

Commands:
  init      Look at the project and create the GitHub Actions pipeline file.
  run       Run the pipeline on your own computer and show the result.
  doctor    Check that Docker and act are ready, and explain what is missing.
  version   Show the installed version.
  help      Show this help.

Options for init:
  --lang fr|en              Language of the messages and of the comments in the created file.
  --project-type python|javascript
                            Project language, when detection is unsure.
  --force                   Replace the pipeline file if it already exists.
  --dry-run                 Show the file without writing anything to disk.

Options for run:
  --lang fr|en              Language of the messages.
  --verbose                 Show the full output of the run.
  --image <reference>       Container image to use, for this run only.

Example:
  firstgreenci init
  firstgreenci run

install.act.darwin:
Install act with Homebrew:
  brew install act
install.act.linux:
Install act with Homebrew:
  brew install act
Or download the executable: https://github.com/nektos/act/releases
install.act.windows:
Install act with winget:
  winget install nektos.act
Or with Scoop:
  scoop install act
install.docker.darwin:
Install Docker Desktop: https://www.docker.com/products/docker-desktop/
1. Download the file for Mac (Apple Silicon or Intel, depending on your machine).
2. Open the downloaded file, then drag Docker into the Applications folder.
3. Start Docker from Applications and let it finish starting up.
install.docker.linux:
Install Docker Engine by following the page for your distribution: https://docs.docker.com/engine/install/
Then allow your account to use it:
  sudo usermod -aG docker $USER
Log out and back in afterwards.
install.docker.windows:
Install Docker Desktop: https://www.docker.com/products/docker-desktop/
1. Download the file for Windows.
2. Run the installer and accept the options it offers.
3. Restart your computer if the installer asks for it, then open Docker Desktop.

unittest only takes classes deriving from unittest.TestCase. If your tests are scripts you run directly, add "pytest" to your dependencies, then run again:
  firstgreenci init --force && firstgreenci run
